p: Shape sudoku: each row and each column has every shape once.
In a 3 by 3 grid with 🔺 🟦 ⚪, each row has all three, with no repeats.
Look at what is already in the row and the column. Put in the missing one.
With 4 objects like 🍎 🍌 🍇 🥭, each row and column has all four.
There can be more than one way to fill a grid. Try another!

remember: Each row and each column has every shape once.

qa.q: Riya keeps her laddoos in a box. Where are the laddoos?
qa.e: She put them in the box. So they are inside it.

qa.q: Which part of a tree is at the top?
qa.e: Leaves are high up on the tree. Roots are at the bottom.

qa.q: Arjun's cat sleeps under his bed. Is the cat above or below the bed?
qa.e: Under means below. So the cat is below the bed.

qa.q: A kite flies high over the house. The kite is ___ the house.
qa.e: High over the house means above the house.

qa.q: Meena plays in the garden. Her mummy is in the kitchen. Who is outside the house?
qa.e: The garden is outside the house. The kitchen is inside.

qa.q: Kabir puts his bag on the chair. Where is the bag?
qa.e: On means resting on the top. So the bag is on top of the chair.

qa.q: Riya ate a toffee. Where should the wrapper go?
qa.e: Garbage goes inside the dustbin. That keeps our home clean.

qa.q: Joseph comes home from the park. His shoes are muddy. Where should they go?
qa.e: Muddy shoes stay outside the room so the room stays clean.

qa.q: Aisha throws a ball. It drops into the basket. What does she call out?
qa.e: The ball went inside the basket. So it is IN.

qa.q: Kabir's ball misses and falls on the grass. Is it IN or OUT?
qa.e: The ball is not inside the basket. So it is OUT.

qa.q: Which one is found inside a room?
qa.e: A bed is kept inside a room. Clouds and trees are outside.

qa.q: Which one is found outside the house?
qa.e: The road is outside the house. So the bus is outside.

qa.q: A parrot sits on a branch. Where is the parrot?
qa.e: A branch is part of the tree. So the parrot is on the tree.

qa.q: Harpreet sits in the cool shade below a neem tree. Where is he?
qa.e: Below the tree means under the tree.

qa.q: Where are your eyebrows?
qa.e: Eyebrows are just above the eyes.

qa.q: Riya draws a smile on a face. Where should it go?
qa.e: The mouth is below the nose. So the smile goes there.

qa.q: A cat sleeps in the shade. A crow sits on a branch. Who is under the tree?
qa.e: The cat is in the shade below the tree. The crow is on the tree.

qa.q: Where is your nose?
qa.e: The nose is below the eyes and above the mouth.

qa.q: How many colours are there in the bands of our flag?
qa.e: The bands are saffron, white and green. That is 3.

qa.q: Which colour is at the top of the Tiranga?
qa.e: Saffron is the top band.

qa.q: Which colour is at the bottom of the Tiranga?
qa.e: Green is the lowest band.

qa.q: Where is the Ashoka Chakra on the flag?
qa.e: The chakra is in the middle of the white band.

qa.q: The white band is below saffron. What is below the white band?
qa.e: Green is below white, at the bottom.

qa.q: Our flag is a rectangle. How many corners does it have?
qa.e: A rectangle has 4 corners, one at each end of the top and the bottom.

qa.q: Clue: The cat is inside the cupboard. Where will you look?
qa.e: Inside the cupboard means we open it and look in.

qa.q: Arjun hid his ball under the chair. Which clue is right?
qa.a: The ball is under the chair
qa.e: The ball is below the chair. So 'under the chair' is right.

qa.q: Which is the best clue?
qa.a: The pen is inside my pencil box
qa.e: It says the place and the position word. Easy to find!

qa.q: The cat sits on the wall. Riya looks under the bed. Will she find it?
qa.e: The cat is on the wall, not under the bed. Riya is looking in the wrong place.

qa.q: Kabir says, 'The toy is behind the TV.' Where should Aisha look?
qa.a: At the back of the TV
qa.e: Behind means at the back.

qa.q: In the song, children look for a lost cat. Which words help most?
qa.a: Position words like on and under
qa.e: On, under and inside tell where to look for the cat.

qa.q: Aisha stands next to her school bag. The bus stop is a long walk away. What is near Aisha?
qa.e: Next to her means close. So the bag is near.

qa.q: Which one is far from us?
qa.e: The sun is very, very far away. That is why it looks small.

qa.q: In the row ⭐ 🌙 ☀️, what is on the far left?
qa.e: Start at the left end of the row. ⭐ comes first.

qa.q: In the row 🥭 🍌 🍎 🍇, what is just right of 🍌?
qa.e: Find 🍌. Move one step right. You reach 🍎.

qa.q: Harpreet sees two trains. One looks big. One looks tiny. Which train is far?
qa.e: Far things look smaller. So the tiny-looking train is far.

qa.q: Five children stand in a line: Riya, Joseph, Meena, Kabir, Aisha. Who is in the middle?
qa.e: Two children are on each side of Meena. So Meena is in the middle.

qa.q: 🚂 🟦 🟦 🟦 🟦 🟦. How many bogies come after the engine?
qa.e: Count the bogies after the engine: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

qa.q: 🚂 🟩 🟩 🟥 🟩. How many bogies are before the 🟥 bogie?
qa.e: Between the engine and 🟥 there are 2 green bogies.

qa.q: 🚂 🟨 🟥 🟨 🟨 🟨. How many bogies are after the 🟥 bogie?
qa.e: After 🟥 come 🟨 🟨 🟨. That is 3.

qa.q: Meena, Joseph and Riya make a human train. Meena is in front, then Joseph, then Riya. Who is just after Meena?
qa.e: Joseph holds Meena from behind. He is just after her.

qa.q: 🚂 ⬜ 🟥 ⬜. Colour the bogie just before 🟥 green. Which one turns green?
qa.e: The bogie just before 🟥 is between the engine and 🟥.

qa.q: Kabir's train passes a bridge. After that it passes a field. What came before the field?
qa.e: He saw the bridge first, so the bridge came before the field.

qa.q: Suwali has 🔴🔵🔴🔴🔵. How many red buttons?
qa.e: Pick out the red ones: 🔴🔴🔴. That is 3.

qa.q: Which button goes in the blue group?
qa.e: Only 🔵 is blue.

qa.q: Why do we sort buttons into groups?
qa.e: When alike things are together, we can count each group fast.

qa.q: Riya sorts leaves: 🍃🍂🍃🍂🍂. How many green leaves 🍃?
qa.e: Pick out the green ones: 🍃🍃. That is 2.

qa.q: Joseph puts grey pebbles in one heap and white pebbles in another. How is he sorting?
qa.e: Grey and white are colours. So he sorts by colour.

qa.q: 🟡🟡🔵🟡🔵. Sort by colour. Which group has more?
qa.e: Yellow has 3. Blue has 2. Yellow has more.

qa.q: Buttons: big 🔵, small 🔵, big 🔴. Sort by size. How many big buttons?
qa.e: The big ones are big 🔵 and big 🔴. That is 2.

qa.q: Meena sorted buttons by colour. Now she sorts the same buttons by holes. Is that fine?
qa.a: Yes, we can sort in a new way
qa.e: The same things can be sorted in many ways.

qa.q: Which is a way to sort buttons?
qa.e: Buttons can have 2 or 4 holes. We can group them that way.

qa.q: There are 4 children and 4 chairs. Each child sits on one chair. How many chairs are left?
qa.e: Each chair got one child. None are left.

qa.q: 5 cups and 3 saucers. Put one saucer under each cup. How many cups get no saucer?
qa.e: 3 cups get saucers. 2 cups are left without one.

qa.q: Arjun has 3 friends and 3 pencils. He gives each friend one pencil. What is true?
qa.a: Same number of friends and pencils
qa.e: Every friend got one and none were left. So they are the same.

qa.q: Which is longer?
qa.e: A cricket bat is much longer than a tiny matchstick.

qa.q: Which is the shortest?
qa.e: A paper clip is the shortest of the three.

qa.q: Meena's ribbon is long. Aisha's ribbon is short. Whose ribbon is longer?
qa.e: Long is more than short. So Meena's ribbon is longer.

qa.q: Two sticks start at the same line. Stick A ends first. Which is shorter?
qa.e: The stick that ends first does not go as far. So Stick A is shorter.

qa.q: Which animal has a long trunk?
qa.e: Only the elephant has a trunk. It is long!

qa.q: Kabir lays a pen next to a ruler. The ruler is longer. Which is shorter?
qa.e: If the ruler is longer, the pen must be shorter.

qa.q: Which one is round all over?
qa.e: A ball is curved everywhere. Books and bricks have flat faces.

qa.q: Which one has flat faces?
qa.e: A dice has 6 flat faces. Oranges and marbles are round.

qa.q: A square gift box is shaped like a ___.
qa.e: A box with square faces is like a cube.

qa.q: A sheet of paper is flat. Which is also flat?
qa.e: A notebook cover is flat like the paper. A laddoo and a ball are round.

qa.q: A tin of ghee has curved sides. What shape is it like?
qa.e: A tin has a curved side and two flat round ends. That is a cylinder.

qa.q: Joseph's birthday cap is pointy at the top. It is like a ___.
qa.e: A birthday cap has a round bottom and a point on top. That is a cone.

qa.q: Which thing has the same shape as a matchbox?
qa.e: A brick has flat faces and corners, just like a matchbox.

qa.q: Riya draws a bangle. Which box should it go in?
qa.e: A bangle is round. Round things go in the circle box.

qa.q: Kabir draws a ladder. Which box should it go in?
qa.e: A ladder is long. Long things go in the rectangle box.

qa.q: Which of these is NOT shaped like a box?
qa.e: A ball is round all over. A brick and a matchbox are box shapes.

qa.q: Meena has a small ball and a big football. Do they have the same shape?
qa.a: Yes, both are round like a ball
qa.e: Size does not change shape. Both are round all over.

qa.q: How many flat faces does a matchbox have?
qa.e: Top, bottom and 4 sides. That is 6 faces.

qa.q: Joseph wants a tall tower. Which is best to stack?
qa.e: Boxes have flat faces. They sit on each other without rolling.

qa.q: Why does a ball fall off a stack?
qa.e: A ball has no flat face to sit on, so it rolls off.

qa.q: Riya makes a toy house from a box. What can be its roof?
qa.e: A cone has a flat bottom and a pointy top, like a roof.

qa.q: Kabir makes a bus from a box. Which can be its wheels?
qa.e: Bottle caps are round like wheels.

qa.q: Meena stacks 3 books. She puts 1 box on top. How many things are in her stack?
qa.e: 3 books and 1 box make 4 things.

qa.q: Aisha says, 'My robot has a box for a body and two glasses for legs.' What is she doing?
qa.e: She names the shapes in her model.

qa.q: Which one rolls?
qa.e: A marble is round. Round things roll.

qa.q: Which one will slide, not roll?
qa.e: A box has flat faces. It slides.

qa.q: Why can a bicycle wheel roll?
qa.e: Round things roll. A wheel is round.

qa.q: Arjun pushes a cube. What does it do?
qa.e: A cube has flat faces. It slides.

qa.q: Which can roll on one side and slide on another?
qa.e: A tin rolls on its curved side. It slides on its flat end.

qa.q: Aisha wants a toy that rolls down a slide. Which should she pick?
qa.e: A ball is round, so it rolls down.

qa.q: Riya writes R or S. What should she write for a football?
qa.e: A football rolls. R means rolls.

qa.q: What should Riya write for a brick?
qa.e: A brick has flat faces. It slides, so S.

qa.q: Which can roll and slide both?
qa.e: A bottle rolls on its curved side and slides on its flat bottom.

qa.q: Kabir pushes an eraser on the floor. What does it do?
qa.e: An eraser has flat faces. It slides.

qa.q: Joseph tests: ball rolls ✓, book ✗, glass rolls ✓, box ✗. How many things can roll?
qa.e: Ball and glass got a tick. That is 2.

qa.q: A tin can rolls on its side. Can it also slide?
qa.e: Stand it on its flat end and push. It slides.

qa.q: A parrot is eating a mango all alone. How many are eating?
qa.e: Just one parrot is eating. That is 1.

qa.q: 3 squirrels are eating. 1 more joins. How many now?
qa.e: 1 more than 3 is 4.

qa.q: What is 1 more than 6?
qa.e: After 6 comes 7.

qa.q: 7 birds share a mango. 1 more comes. Then 1 more comes. How many now?
qa.e: 7, then 8, then 9.

qa.q: Friends join one by one. Count on: 5, 6, 7, ___, 9.
qa.e: After 7 comes 8, then 9.

qa.q: Count the mango eaters: 🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦🐦. How many in all?
qa.e: Touch each bird once: 1 to 9.

qa.q: 🐦🐦🐦 How many fingers will you show for these birds?
qa.e: One finger for each bird. 3 birds, 3 fingers.

qa.q: Riya shows 5 fingers. How many dots should she draw?
qa.e: One dot for each finger. 5 fingers, 5 dots.

qa.q: Kabir draws ● ● ● ● ● ● ●. How many fingers match?
qa.e: Count the dots: 1 to 7. Show 7 fingers.

qa.q: Which dot card matches 2 fingers?
qa.e: 2 fingers need 2 dots.

qa.q: Joseph holds up a whole hand and 1 more finger. How many dots match?
qa.e: A whole hand is 5. One more is 6.

qa.q: Which dot card shows the same number as 4 birds?
qa.e: 4 birds need 4 dots, one for each.

qa.q: 5 children and 5 brushes. One brush each. How many brushes are left?
qa.e: Each child got one. No brush is left.

qa.q: 4 children and 6 crayons. One crayon each. What is true?
qa.e: After each child gets one, 2 crayons are left. So more crayons.

qa.q: ☕☕☕ 🥄🥄🥄🥄🥄. Which group has fewer?
qa.e: 3 cups, 5 spoons. 3 is fewer than 5.

qa.q: 6 children and 4 sheets. How many children do not get a sheet?
qa.e: 4 children get sheets. 2 children are left without.

qa.q: ☕☕☕☕ 🥄🥄. Circle the group with fewer items.
qa.e: 2 spoons and 4 cups. Spoons are fewer.

qa.q: 3 children each get one pencil. 2 pencils are left. How many pencils were there?
qa.e: 3 given out and 2 left. 3 + 2 = 5.

qa.q: Which is more?
qa.e: 9 comes after 6 when we count. So 9 is more.

qa.q: Which is the least?
qa.e: 2 comes first when we count. It is the smallest.

qa.q: Aisha has 🍬🍬🍬🍬. Joseph has 🍬🍬. Who has fewer sweets?
qa.e: Joseph has 2. Aisha has 4. 2 is less than 4.

qa.q: Kabir has 5 kites. Harpreet has 3 kites. How many more does Kabir have?
qa.e: Match 3 kites each. Kabir has 2 extra.

qa.q: Which is one more than 6?
qa.e: One more than 6 is the next number: 7.

qa.q: Meena has 4 bangles. Riya has 4 bangles. What is true?
qa.e: Both have 4. So they have the same number.

qa.q: What comes just after 4?
qa.e: Count 1, 2, 3, 4. Next is 5.

qa.q: What comes just before 9?
qa.e: Count 7, 8, 9. Just before 9 is 8.

qa.q: Which number is between 6 and 8?
qa.e: 6, 7, 8. The number in between is 7.

qa.q: How do we write 'three' as a number?
qa.e: Three is written as 3.

qa.q: Count: 2, 3, 4, ___, 6. What is missing?
qa.e: After 4 comes 5. Then 6.

qa.q: There are 9 steps. Riya has climbed 8. How many more steps to the top?
qa.e: From 8, one more step makes 9.

qa.q: How do we write the number 'six'?
qa.e: Six is written as 6.

qa.q: Riya must colour 5 of these flowers: 🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸. How many stay uncoloured?
qa.e: 7 flowers, 5 coloured. 6, 7 are left: 2.

qa.q: Kabir drew 🍌🍌🍌. He must draw 4 fruits. How many more should he draw?
qa.e: He has 3. One more makes 4.

qa.q: Aisha has to colour 8 stars. Which shows 8?
qa.e: Count each row. Only the first one has 8.

qa.q: Joseph has to colour 6 balls. He has coloured 4. How many more?
qa.e: 4, then 5, 6. That is 2 more.

qa.q: Meena writes how many fingers are on one hand. What does she write?
qa.e: One hand has 5 fingers.

qa.q: How many mangoes? 🥭🥭🥭🥭🥭
qa.e: Touch and count: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

qa.q: How many diyas? 🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔
qa.e: Count each diya once: 1 to 7.

qa.q: Arjun has no balloons. How many balloons does he have?
qa.e: No balloons means zero. We write 0.

qa.q: How many stars? ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Meena counts 1, 2, 3, 4 laddoos. How many laddoos are there?
qa.e: The last number she said is 4. So there are 4.

qa.q: How many footballs? 🏏 ⚽ ⚽ ⚽
qa.e: 🏏 is a bat, not a ball. Count only the footballs: 3.

qa.q: In a dot-to-dot, you are at dot 4. Which dot is next?
qa.e: After 4 comes 5.

qa.q: Cards 6, 1, 3. Which is the smallest?
qa.e: 1 comes first when we count.

qa.q: Put 8, 4, 6 from smallest to largest. Which card is in the middle?
qa.e: In order: 4, 6, 8. 6 is in the middle.

qa.q: Which is in order from smallest to largest?
qa.e: 2 is less than 5, and 5 is less than 9.

qa.q: Riya joins dots 1, 2, 3, 5. Which dot did she miss?
qa.e: After 3 comes 4, then 5.

qa.q: Cards 9, 7, 8. Smallest to largest, which card goes last?
qa.e: In order: 7, 8, 9. 9 is last.

qa.q: 🍎🍎🍎🍎🍎 and 🍎🍎🍎. How many fruits in all?
qa.e: 5 and 3 make 8.

qa.q: Which two groups make 7 umbrellas?
qa.e: 4 and 3 make 7. The others make 8.

qa.q: Riya splits 6 beads into two parts. One part has 2. How many in the other?
qa.e: 2 and 4 make 6.

qa.q: Which is NOT a way to make 5?
qa.e: 3 and 3 make 6, not 5.

qa.q: 9 is 5 and ___.
qa.e: 5 and 4 make 9.

qa.q: Kabir has 8 marbles in two pockets. One pocket has all 8. How many in the other?
qa.e: 8 and 0 make 8. The other pocket is empty.

qa.q: Dotty Bug has ●●●●●● on her back. How many dots?
qa.e: Count each dot once: 1 to 6.

qa.q: Riya makes a design with 3 bindis on top and 2 below. How many bindis?
qa.e: 3 and 2 make 5.

qa.q: Which shows the same number as ●●●●?
qa.e: 2 and 2 make 4. It just looks different.

qa.q: Kabir uses 7 seeds for a flower design. He adds 1 seed in the middle. How many seeds now?
qa.e: 1 more than 7 is 8.

qa.q: Bug A: ● ● ●. Bug B: ●● and ●. What is true?
qa.e: Bug A has 3. Bug B has 2 and 1, which is 3.

qa.q: Aisha makes 2 rows of buttons with 4 in each row. How many buttons?
qa.e: 4 and 4 make 8.

qa.q: Arjun rolls ⚄. How many boxes does he colour?
qa.e: ⚄ has 5 dots. He colours 5 boxes.

qa.q: Which dice face shows 3?
qa.e: ⚂ has 3 dots.

qa.q: Meena rolls ⚅. Joseph rolls ⚃. Who colours more boxes?
qa.e: ⚅ is 6 and ⚃ is 4. 6 is more.

qa.q: What is the most dots on one face of a dice?
qa.e: The faces go from 1 to 6. The most is 6.

qa.q: Aisha rolls ⚁ and then ⚂. How many boxes does she colour in all?
qa.e: 2 and 3 make 5.

qa.q: Kabir coloured 4 boxes. Riya coloured 4 boxes. Who wins?
qa.e: Both have 4. Equal means a tie.

qa.q: 4 birds sit on a branch. All 4 fly away. How many are left?
qa.e: All flew away, so none are left. That is 0.

qa.q: How many suns can you see in the sky at night?
qa.e: The sun is not in the sky at night. So 0.

qa.q: Riya's lunch box is empty. How many idlis are in it?
qa.e: Empty means no idlis. That is 0.

qa.q: Which number comes just before 1?
qa.e: Counting back from 1 gives 0.

qa.q: 3 birds on a branch. 1 flies away. How many are left?
qa.e: 3 take away 1 is 2.

qa.q: Which is the least: 3, 0 or 1?
qa.e: 0 means none. It is less than any other count.

qa.q: Joseph's cake has 10 candles. 7 are lit. How many are not lit?
qa.e: 7 and 3 make 10. So 3 are not lit.

qa.q: A ten frame has 2 rows of 5 boxes. How many boxes in all?
qa.e: 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: A ten frame has 8 buttons. How many boxes are empty?
qa.e: 8 and 2 make 10.

qa.q: Riya's bead string has 5 beads. She wants 10. How many more?
qa.e: 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: A ten frame has just 1 empty box. What number does it show?
qa.e: 10 boxes with 1 empty means 9 buttons.

qa.q: Count the diyas at the party: 🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔🪔. How many?
qa.e: Count each diya once: 1 to 10.

qa.q: How many fingers on two hands?
qa.e: 5 on one hand and 5 on the other. 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: 8 laddoos are on a plate. How many more make 10?
qa.e: Count on from 8: 9, 10. That is 2 more.

qa.q: What comes just after 9?
qa.e: After 9 comes 10.

qa.q: 4 and ___ make 10.
qa.e: Count on from 4: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. That is 6.

qa.q: Riya has 5 red bangles and 5 green bangles. How many in all?
qa.e: 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: A box holds 10 pencils. It has 3. How many more fit?
qa.e: Count on from 3 to 10: that is 7 more.

qa.q: Partner game: Meena shows 4 fingers. How many must Arjun show to make 10?
qa.e: 4 and 6 make 10.

qa.q: 10 beads in a row. A stick goes after the 3rd bead. How many beads are after the stick?
qa.e: 3 and 7 make 10.

qa.q: Which pair splits 10?
qa.e: 6 and 4 make 10. The others make 9.

qa.q: Riya splits 10 shells. The left part has 5. How many in the right part?
qa.e: 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: Joseph shows 8 fingers. His friend shows 2. How many fingers in all?
qa.e: 8 and 2 make 10.

qa.q: 10 beads. The stick is after the 9th bead. How many beads are after it?
qa.e: 9 and 1 make 10.

qa.q: 1 ten and 6 ones make ___.
qa.e: 1 ten is 10. 10 and 6 make 16.

qa.q: How many ones are in 13?
qa.e: 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones.

qa.q: How many tens are in 20?
qa.e: 10 and 10 make 20. That is 2 tens.

qa.q: Kabir has 10 laddoos in a box and 5 loose. How many laddoos?
qa.e: 10 and 5 make 15.

qa.q: Which number has 1 ten and 9 ones?
qa.e: 1 ten is 10. 10 and 9 make 19.

qa.q: Meena has 17 beads. She makes a group of 10. How many beads are left over?
qa.e: 17 is 1 ten and 7 ones. 7 beads are left over.

qa.q: Count the flowers: 🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼🌼
qa.e: Circle 10, then count on 11, 12, 13.

qa.q: One full ten frame and 5 more dots. What number is it?
qa.e: 10 and 5 make 15.

qa.q: Aisha has 18 bangles. She circles 10. How many are outside the circle?
qa.e: 10 and 8 make 18.

qa.q: To show 12, Kabir fills one ten frame. How many dots go in the second frame?
qa.e: 10 and 2 make 12.
Two groups of ten make 20.

qa.q: Which shows 17?
qa.e: 10 and 7 make 17.

qa.q: What comes just after 17?
qa.e: 17, then 18.

qa.q: What comes just before 20?
qa.e: 18, 19, 20. Just before 20 is 19.

qa.q: Which number is between 12 and 14?
qa.e: 12, 13, 14. 13 is in between.

qa.q: Which is bigger, 18 or 15?
qa.e: 18 comes after 15 when counting. So 18 is bigger.

qa.q: Count: 15, 16, ___, 18. What is missing?
qa.e: After 16 comes 17.

qa.q: How do we write 'twelve'?
qa.e: Twelve is 1 ten and 2 ones. We write 12.

qa.q: Which is the smallest: 15, 7, 11?
qa.e: 7 comes first when we count.

qa.q: Which is the biggest: 18, 20, 9?
qa.e: 20 comes last when we count.

qa.q: Put 12, 19, 5 from biggest to smallest. Which comes first?
qa.e: 19 is the biggest, so it comes first.

qa.q: Tower A has 9 blocks, Tower B has 14, Tower C has 11. Which has the most blocks?
qa.e: 14 is more than 11 and 9.

qa.q: Which tower has the fewest blocks: A has 13, B has 16, C has 10?
qa.e: 10 is less than 13 and 16.

qa.q: Dot-to-dot: you are at dot 17. Which dot is next?
qa.e: After 17 comes 18.

qa.q: 🍎🍎🍎 and 🍎🍎. How many apples in all?
qa.e: 3 and 2 make 5. Count all: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

qa.q: What is 4 + 4?
qa.e: Start at 4. Count on 4: 5, 6, 7, 8.

qa.q: Arjun has 5 marbles. He finds 2 more. How many now?
qa.e: Start at 5. Count on 2: 6, 7.

qa.q: 6 children play cricket. 3 more join. How many play now?
qa.e: Start at 6. Count on 3: 7, 8, 9.

qa.q: What is 7 + 0?
qa.e: Adding 0 adds nothing. So it stays 7.

qa.q: Meena has 2 red balloons and 6 blue ones. How many balloons?
qa.e: Start at 6. Count on 2: 7, 8.

qa.q: Kabir draws 4 stars. Then he draws 3 more. How many stars now?
qa.e: 4 and 3 more make 7.

qa.q: Meena's family has 3 people. Joseph's family has 6. How many people in all?
qa.e: Start at 6 and count on 3: 7, 8, 9.

qa.q: How many fingers and toes do you have in all?
qa.e: 10 fingers and 10 toes make 20.

qa.q: Aisha shows 5 fingers on one hand and 2 on the other. How many fingers?
qa.e: 5 and 2 make 7.

qa.q: How many toes are on your two feet?
qa.e: 5 toes on each foot. 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: Harpreet shows all the fingers of one hand and 4 of the other. How many fingers?
qa.e: A whole hand is 5. 5 and 4 make 9.

qa.q: Meena's scoreboard shows ✓✓✓✓✓. How many rounds did she win?
qa.e: Count the ticks: 1 to 5.

qa.q: Arjun has ✓✓✓. Joseph has ✓✓✓✓✓✓. Who won more rounds?
qa.e: Joseph has 6 ticks. Arjun has 3. 6 is more.

qa.q: Riya has ✓✓✓✓. Aisha has ✓✓. How many more rounds did Riya win?
qa.e: 4 is 2 more than 2.

qa.q: Kabir rolls ⚄. Harpreet rolls ⚂. Who gets a tick?
qa.e: ⚄ is 5. ⚂ is 3. 5 is bigger, so Kabir wins the round.

qa.q: They played 7 rounds with no ties. Riya won 4. Kabir won the rest. How many did Kabir win?
qa.e: 4 and 3 make 7.

qa.q: What does one tick on the scoreboard show?
qa.e: We put one tick each time a player wins a round.

qa.q: Riya colours 3 beads red and 4 beads blue. How many beads in all?
qa.e: 3 and 4 make 7.

qa.q: Start at 6 on the number strip. Hop 2 forward. Where do you land?
qa.e: 6, then 7, then 8.

qa.q: How do you find 4 + 5 on a number strip?
qa.e: Start at the first number and hop the second number.

qa.q: Kabir hops 3 and lands on 9. Where did he start?
qa.e: 6 + 3 = 9. He started at 6.

qa.q: Hop to find 2 + 7. Where do you land?
qa.e: Start at 2 and hop 7: you land on 9.

qa.q: A mala has 5 green beads and 5 yellow beads. How many beads?
qa.e: 5 and 5 make 10.

qa.q: Riya knows 5 + 2 = 7. What is 2 + 5?
qa.e: Changing the order does not change the sum.

qa.q: Joseph counts all to find 3 + 5. Aisha counts on from 5. Who is right?
qa.e: Both ways give 8. Any correct way is fine.

qa.q: Which pair makes 9?
Which is the same as 4 + 3?
qa.e: 3 + 4 uses the same numbers, so it is also 7.

qa.q: Kabir has 8 marbles in two bags. One bag has 6. How many in the other?
qa.e: 6 and 2 make 8.

qa.q: 4 ducks swim. 2 more come. Add or take away?
qa.e: More ducks come. So we add.

qa.q: 4 ducks swim. 2 more come. How many ducks now?
8 crayons are in a box. 3 fall out. How many are in the box?
qa.e: Some go away, so take away. 8 - 3 = 5.

qa.q: Which is bigger: 5 + 2 or 5 - 2?
3 + ___ = 8. What is missing?
qa.e: Count on from 3 to 8: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. That is 5.

qa.q: Riya has 9 diyas. 4 blow out. How many still glow?
qa.e: Some go out, so take away. 9 - 4 = 5.

qa.q: Meena's bag has 4 books and 3 notebooks. How many in all?
qa.e: 4 and 3 make 7.

qa.q: Which is an addition story?
qa.a: I had 2 pens. Papa gave me 3 more.
qa.e: Getting more means the groups join. We add.

qa.q: A line has 2 and 3. Which number makes the line add to 6?
qa.e: 2 + 3 = 5. 1 more makes 6.

qa.q: What is 1 + 2 + 3?
A line has 3 and 1. Which number completes it to make 6?
qa.e: 3 + 1 = 4. 2 more makes 6.

qa.q: Arjun's bag has 5 pencils and 4 erasers. How many things in his story?
qa.e: 5 and 4 make 9.

qa.q: 5 children are on the bus. 1 gets down. How many are left?
qa.e: One fewer than 5 is 4.

qa.q: 4 children are on the bus. 1 gets down at each stop. After 4 stops, how many are left?
qa.e: 4, 3, 2, 1, 0. Nobody is left.

qa.q: 3 children. 1 gets down at the first stop and 1 at the next. How many are left?
qa.e: 3, then 2, then 1.

qa.q: Riya draws 6 kites and crosses out 2. How many kites are not crossed out?
qa.e: 6 take away 2 is 4.

qa.q: Which sentence matches 7 balls with 3 crossed out?
qa.e: 7 balls, 3 taken away, 4 left.

qa.q: Only 1 child is on the bus. She gets down. How many are left?
qa.e: 1 take away 1 leaves 0. The bus is empty.

qa.q: 5 birds sit on a wire. 2 fly away. How many stay?
qa.e: Count back 2 from 5: 4, 3. 3 birds stay.

qa.q: What is 9 - 3?
qa.e: Count back 3 from 9: 8, 7, 6.

qa.q: Aisha has 7 balloons. 4 pop. How many are left?
qa.e: Count back 4 from 7: 6, 5, 4, 3.

qa.q: Joseph has 6 rotis. He eats all 6. How many are left?
qa.e: All are eaten. None are left. 6 - 6 = 0.

qa.q: What is 8 - 0?
qa.e: Taking away nothing leaves 8.

qa.q: Harpreet has 9 stickers. She gives 5 to Riya. How many does she keep?
qa.e: Count back 5 from 9: 8, 7, 6, 5, 4.

qa.q: A card has 6 dots. A paper hides some. You see 4. How many are hidden?
qa.e: 4 and 2 make 6. So 2 are hidden.

qa.q: 9 dots in all. 3 can be seen. How many are hidden?
qa.e: 3 and 6 make 9.

qa.q: Aisha has 7 shells. Some are under a cup. 2 are outside. How many are under the cup?
qa.e: 2 and 5 make 7.
If 5 and 3 make 8, then taking 3 from 8 leaves 5.

qa.q: Kabir sees 4 dots. He knows 4 more are hidden. How many dots in all?
qa.e: 4 seen and 4 hidden make 8.

qa.q: Which fact goes with 2 + 5 = 7?
qa.e: The same three numbers: 2, 5 and 7.

qa.q: Start at 9. Hop back 3. Where do you land?
Find 8 - 5.
qa.e: Hop back 5 from 8: 7, 6, 5, 4, 3.

qa.q: Meena counts up from 4 to 9 to find 9 - 4. How many hops does she make?
Joseph says 7 - 3 = 4. How can he check?
qa.a: Add 4 + 3 and see if it is 7
qa.e: 4 + 3 = 7, so his answer is right.

qa.q: Use the number strip. What is 10 - 6?
qa.e: Hop back 6 from 10: you land on 4.

qa.q: Riya hops back 2 from 6. Kabir counts up from 2 to 6. What do they both get?
qa.e: Both ways give 6 - 2 = 4.

qa.q: What is 9 + 4?
qa.e: Make 10: 9 + 1 = 10. Then add the 3 left: 13.

qa.q: What is 10 + 6?
qa.e: 1 ten and 6 ones make 16.

qa.q: Arjun has 7 tomatoes. He picks 7 more. How many now?
qa.e: 7 + 3 = 10. Then 4 more: 14.

qa.q: Which is the same as 5 + 8?
qa.e: Changing the order does not change the sum. Both are 13.

qa.q: What is 6 + 9?
Kabir has 11 peas. He finds 8 more. How many peas?
qa.e: Start at 11. Count on 8: up to 19.

qa.q: 7 tomatoes and 5 more tomatoes. Fill in: 7 + 5 = ___
qa.e: 7 + 3 makes 10, then 2 more makes 12.

qa.q: Start at 11 on the number line. Hop 6. Where do you land?
On a mala, Riya slides 9 beads and then 4 more. How many beads?
qa.e: 9 + 1 makes 10, then 3 more makes 13.

qa.q: Kabir starts at 13 and hops 5. Where does he land?
Which hops show 6 + 8?
qa.e: Start at one number, hop the other.

qa.q: What is 12 + 6?
14 + 3 is the same as 10 + ___.
qa.e: 4 ones + 3 ones = 7 ones.

qa.q: Find 15 + 4.
Meena adds 11 + 5 by counting on. Arjun splits 11 into 10 and 1. Who is right?
qa.e: Both ways give 16. There is more than one good way.

qa.q: How do we split 13 to add?
qa.e: 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones: 10 and 3.

qa.q: Riya has 16 bindis. She gets 4 more. How many now?
Aisha has 8 pencils. She buys 6 more. How many pencils now?
qa.e: 8 + 2 = 10, then 4 more makes 14.

qa.q: Dadi makes 9 laddoos in the morning and 7 at night. How many laddoos?
qa.e: 9 + 1 = 10, then 6 more makes 16.

qa.q: Riya wears 7 bangles on one hand and 5 on the other. How many bangles?
qa.e: 7 + 3 = 10, then 2 more makes 12.

qa.q: For the picnic, Joseph packs 4 bananas, 5 oranges and 3 apples. How many fruits?
The picnic basket has 10 puris and 8 parathas. How many in all?
Which word in a story tells us to add?
qa.e: Altogether means put all together.

qa.q: What is 15 - 5?
qa.e: Take away the 5 ones from 15. 10 is left.

qa.q: What is 12 - 3?
qa.e: Take 2 to reach 10. Take 1 more: 9.

qa.q: 17 brinjals grow. Riya picks 7. How many are still growing?
qa.e: 17 take away 7 is 10.

qa.q: What is 20 - 8?
qa.e: Count up from 8 to 10 is 2. Then 10 more to 20. 2 + 10 = 12.

qa.q: What is 14 - 9?
qa.e: Count up from 9: 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. That is 5.

qa.q: Aisha has 16 beans. She plants 8. How many are left?
Which way reaches 15?
Riya starts at 9 and lands on 16. How many did she hop forward?
Kabir starts at 20 and hops back 3. Where does he land?
Which one does NOT land on 10?
Meena hops 8 + 5. Joseph hops 20 - 7. Do they land on the same number?
Start at 11. How many hops forward to reach 19?
A farmer has 12 hens. 5 more come. How many hens in all?
qa.e: More come, so add. 12 + 5 = 17.

qa.q: There are 18 mangoes. A monkey takes 6. How many are left?
qa.e: Taken away, so subtract. 18 - 6 = 12.

qa.q: Joseph plants 8 seeds on Monday and 9 on Tuesday. How many seeds altogether?
qa.e: Altogether means add. 8 + 9 = 17.

qa.q: Meena has 15 cucumbers. She sells 9. How many are left?
qa.e: Sells means they go away. 15 - 9 = 6.

qa.q: A cart has 10 pumpkins. 10 more are loaded. How many now?
qa.e: Loaded means more. 10 + 10 = 20.

qa.q: Riya had 13 peas. A bird ate some. Now she has 8. How many did the bird eat?
qa.e: Count up from 8 to 13: that is 5.

qa.q: Potter Ramu made 8 diyas. He sold 5. Then he made 6 more. How many diyas now?
A bus has 10 children. 4 get on. Then 3 get off. How many now?
At a stop, 2 children get on the bus. Add or take away?
qa.e: Getting on means more children. We add.

qa.q: Riya has 15 toffees. She eats 3. Mummy gives her 4. How many now?
A bus has 7 children. 6 get on. Then 5 get off. How many now?
Meena made 9 diyas and then 9 more. She sold 11. How many are left?
Lina's family: 👴👵👨👩👧👶. How many people?
qa.e: Count each one once: 1 to 6.

qa.q: Mummy is taller than Lina. Lina is taller than Tinu. Who is in between?
qa.e: Lina is shorter than Mummy but taller than Tinu.

qa.q: Arjun is taller than Riya but shorter than Dada. Who is the tallest?
qa.e: Dada is taller than Arjun, and Arjun is taller than Riya.

qa.q: Meena is shorter than her brother. Who is taller?
qa.e: If Meena is shorter, her brother is taller.

qa.q: Kabir and Joseph stand back to back. Kabir's head is higher. Who is taller?
qa.e: The higher head belongs to the taller child.

qa.q: At the get-together, 3 cousins and 4 aunts and uncles came. How many came?
qa.e: 3 and 4 make 7.

qa.q: Who is taller?
qa.e: A grown-up is taller than a small baby.

qa.q: Which is the tallest?
qa.e: A coconut tree grows very high. It is the tallest.

qa.q: Arjun is taller than Kabir. Who is shorter?
qa.e: If Arjun is taller, Kabir must be shorter.

qa.q: Riya is taller than Aisha. Aisha is taller than Joseph. Who is the shortest?
qa.e: Riya is taller than Aisha. Aisha is taller than Joseph. So Joseph is the shortest.

qa.q: Meena stands on a chair. Harpreet stands on the floor. Is it fair to compare their heights?
qa.e: No. Both must stand on the same floor to compare fairly.

qa.q: Which is taller?
qa.e: A bus is much taller than a bicycle.

qa.q: Riya's house is 4 steps from the shop. Kabir's house is 9 steps. Whose house is nearer to the shop?
qa.e: 4 steps is fewer than 9 steps. Fewer steps means nearer.

qa.q: School: 20 steps. Temple: 35 steps. Park: 10 steps. Which is nearest?
qa.e: 10 is the fewest steps.

qa.q: Well: 6 steps. Shop: 15 steps. Bus stop: 3 steps. Which is farthest?
qa.e: 15 is the most steps.

qa.q: Joseph walks 7 steps to the tap and 12 steps to the gate. How many more steps to the gate?
qa.e: 12 is 5 more than 7.

qa.q: Which is farther from you: your nose or the moon?
qa.e: The moon is very far away in the sky.

qa.q: Aisha is 3 steps from the bus. Meena is 8 steps. Harpreet is 5 steps. Who is nearest to the bus?
qa.e: 3 steps is the fewest.

qa.q: Which is the thickest?
qa.e: A tree trunk is very wide.

qa.q: Which is the thinnest?
qa.e: A hair is the narrowest.

qa.q: Three pencils start at the same end. The red one ends last. Which is the longest?
qa.e: The one that goes farthest is the longest.

qa.q: Why do we line things up at one end before comparing lengths?
qa.e: With the same start, the end shows which is longer.

qa.q: Which is the longest?
qa.e: A train has many coaches. It is the longest.

qa.q: Strips made of the same blocks: green 6, blue 9, red 4. Which is the shortest?
qa.e: 4 blocks is the fewest, so red is shortest.

qa.q: Riya measures two desks with her hand. The red desk is 4 handspans. The blue desk is 6. Which is longer?
qa.e: 6 of her handspans is more than 4. So the blue desk is longer.

qa.q: A pencil is 5 paper clips long. How many clips fit along it?
qa.e: 5 clips long means 5 clips fit end to end.

qa.q: Which is best to measure the length of a classroom?
qa.e: A classroom is big. Footsteps are quicker for big things.

qa.q: Meena measures her book with blocks: 🟦🟦🟦. How many blocks long?
qa.e: Count the blocks: 1, 2, 3.

qa.q: Aisha measures two mats with her hand. The green mat is 8 handspans. The red is 5. How many more is green?
qa.e: 8 - 5 = 3. The green mat is 3 handspans longer.

qa.q: Joseph measures a rope. He leaves big gaps between his clips. Is his answer right?
qa.a: No, there should be no gaps
qa.e: Clips must touch end to end. Gaps give a wrong count.

qa.q: Which is best measured with finger widths?
qa.e: An eraser is small. Finger widths fit it well.

qa.q: Which is best measured with handspans?
qa.e: A table is big. Handspans are quicker.

qa.q: Kabir guesses 6 handspans. He measures 8. How many more than his guess?
qa.e: 8 is 2 more than 6.

qa.q: Meena's arm is 3 of her handspans. Aisha's arm is 4 of her handspans. Can both be right?
qa.a: Yes, hands and arms are different sizes
qa.e: Different hands and arms give different counts.

qa.q: Joseph guesses a book is 10 finger widths. He measures 7. Was his guess more or less?
qa.e: 10 is more than 7.

qa.q: What should you do first?
qa.e: We guess first, then measure to check.

qa.q: Dada and Riya measure the same rug with footsteps. Who takes more steps?
qa.e: Riya's feet are smaller. More small steps fit.

qa.q: Papa's table is 6 of his handspans. Lina gets 9 of her handspans. Who has the bigger hand?
qa.e: Fewer handspans fit, so Papa's hand is bigger.

qa.q: A rope is 4 pencils long. It is also ___ clips long.
qa.e: A clip is smaller than a pencil. More clips fit along the rope.

qa.q: Arjun and Kabir must compare their desks fairly. What should they do?
qa.e: Using the same unit makes the comparison fair.

qa.q: A stick is 3 big erasers long. Harpreet measures it with small erasers. Which count can be right?
qa.e: Small erasers are shorter, so more fit. Only 6 is more than 3.

qa.q: Meena's book is 7 clips long. Aisha's book is 7 clips long, with the same clips. What is true?
qa.e: Same clips, same count. So the books are the same length.

qa.q: Which is heavier?
qa.e: A watermelon is much harder to lift.

qa.q: Which is lighter?
qa.e: A leaf is very easy to lift.

qa.q: Kabir holds a book and a pencil. His book hand goes down. Which is heavier?
qa.e: The hand pulled down holds the heavier thing.

qa.q: Which is true?
qa.a: A big balloon can be lighter than a small stone
qa.e: Size does not always tell weight.

qa.q: Riya weighs 20 kg. Her brother weighs 15 kg. Who is heavier?
qa.e: 20 is more than 15.

qa.q: Where can we check how heavy we are?
qa.e: A weighing machine shows weight.

qa.q: One bucket is filled with 7 mugs. Another needs 10 mugs. How many more mugs for the second?
qa.e: 10 is 3 more than 7.

qa.q: Which holds the most water?
qa.e: A bucket is the biggest container here.

qa.q: Using the same cup, a bottle takes 5 cups and a jug takes 8. Which holds less?
qa.e: 5 cups is less than 8 cups.

qa.q: Which needs the most water?
qa.e: A bath needs a whole bucket of water.

qa.q: Kabir fills a pot using 4 glasses. Then he fills a second pot the same way. How many glasses in all?
qa.e: 4 and 4 make 8.

qa.q: Why must we use the same cup to compare two bottles?
qa.e: Different cups hold different amounts, so counts would not match.

qa.q: Count the neem leaves: 🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃🍃
qa.e: Make two tens (20), then count on 21, 22, 23.

qa.q: What comes just after 29?
qa.e: After 29 comes 30.

qa.q: How do we write 'twenty-six'?
qa.e: Twenty is 2 tens, six is 6 ones: 26.

qa.q: Riya has 2 bunches of 10 flowers and 5 more. How many flowers?
qa.e: 20 and 5 make 25.
After 25 comes 26.

qa.q: Which number is twenty-eight?
qa.e: Twenty-eight is 2 tens and 8 ones: 28.

qa.q: What is 6 tens?
qa.e: Count in tens 6 times: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60.

qa.q: Count in tens: 30, 40, ___, 60. What is missing?
qa.e: Each step adds one ten. After 40 comes 50.

qa.q: Riya has 3 bundles of 10 sticks. How many sticks?
qa.e: 10, 20, 30. Three tens make 30.

qa.q: How many tens make 80?
What comes after 90 when counting in tens?
qa.e: 90 and one more ten make 100.

qa.q: Kabir has 2 packs of 10 pencils. How many pencils?
qa.e: 10, 20. Two tens make 20.

qa.q: What number is 3 tens and 6 ones?
qa.e: 3 tens is 30. 30 and 6 make 36.

qa.q: How many tens are in 72?
qa.e: In 72, the 7 is the tens digit. So 7 tens.

qa.q: How many ones are in 49?
qa.e: In 49, the 9 is the ones digit.

qa.q: Meena has ₹10 notes and ₹1 coins. 2 notes and 5 coins. How much?
Which number has 8 tens and 0 ones?
qa.e: 8 tens is 80. No ones, so 80.

qa.q: Harpreet makes 2 tens and 3 ones with sticks. What number?
qa.e: 2 tens is 20. 20 and 3 make 23.

qa.q: How many full ten frames show 40?
qa.e: 40 is 4 tens, so 4 full frames.

qa.q: 3 full ten frames and 8 more dots. What number is it?
qa.e: 30 and 8 make 38.

qa.q: Which number comes just after 49?
qa.e: After 49 comes 50.

qa.q: To show 45, how many dots go in the frame that is not full?
qa.e: 45 is 4 full frames and 5 more.

qa.q: Count the beads: 3 strings of 10 and 6 loose beads.
qa.e: 30 and 6 make 36.

qa.q: Which number is forty-three?
qa.e: Forty is 4 tens, three is 3 ones: 43.

qa.q: Where does card 28 go on the string?
qa.e: 28 is 1 more than 27 and 1 less than 29.

qa.q: Riya reads the cards: 41, 42, ___, 44. Which card is missing?
qa.e: After 42 comes 43.

qa.q: Which card goes just before 30?
qa.e: Just before 30 is 29.

qa.q: Kabir clipped 47 between 46 and 48. Is he right?
qa.e: 46, 47, 48 is the counting order.

qa.q: A card says forty-nine. Which card is it?
qa.e: Forty-nine is 4 tens and 9 ones: 49.

qa.q: If we go on after 50, which card comes next?
qa.e: 1 more than 50 is 51.

qa.q: Joseph counts marbles: 4 groups of 10 and 7 more. How many?
qa.e: 40 and 7 make 47.
After 37 comes 38.

qa.q: In a number chart, which number is just below 17?
qa.e: Going down adds 10: 17 + 10 = 27.
Three tens (30) and 2 more make 32.
It goes down by 1. After 48 comes 47.

qa.q: What is missing: 20, 30, ___, 50?
qa.e: It goes up by 10. 30 + 10 = 40.

qa.q: What comes just after 99?
qa.e: 1 more than 99 is 100.

qa.q: Which is the biggest 2-digit number?
qa.e: 99 has 2 digits. 100 has 3 digits.

qa.q: Dadi sews 7 groups of 10 mirrors and 4 more. How many mirrors?
qa.e: 70 and 4 make 74.
After 79 comes 80.

qa.q: How do we write 'eighty-five'?
qa.e: Eighty is 8 tens, five is 5 ones: 85.
